purpose: User-authorized matched test of after-hours and premarket information with regular-session execution
seed_rule: Original five plus the first five in the previously frozen 20-new-seed list, in protocol order; no return-based seed selection. Primary equal-rank ensemble uses all ten; original-five and new-five subgroup results are diagnostics.
data: Reuse and hash-verify the 1288 literal-ticker raw SIP 15-minute chunks, exchange calendar, issuer-date rules and reviewed historical daily economic panel. No new universe, outcome or eligibility filtering.
after_hours: Signal session regular close (13:00 on early closes, otherwise 16:00) through 20:00 America/New_York. Include only complete 15-minute bars ending by cutoff.
premarket: Following EXCHANGE SESSION from 04:00 through 09:15 America/New_York, attached to the preceding daily signal index. This includes Monday premarket after Friday and skips exchange holidays.
decision_time: All three views form share orders at 09:20 ET on the entry session, using bars ending no later than 09:15. Share sizing deliberately uses the preceding regular close's known NAV, prices and ADV, preserving the existing accounting formula. It does not use premarket marks or pretend the forecast existed at the previous close.
execution: Those fixed share orders fill at the SAME ENTRY SESSION regular close; all data cutoffs precede it. Original five-session close-to-close targets, continuous $1m accounts, cancellation, cash scaling, 1% ADV limits, acquisition approximations and final liquidation remain unchanged. No extended-hours executions.
feature_semantics: AH return anchors to the same-date raw closing regular-session bar; PM return is within that premarket window. No cross-date raw price gap or share-volume ratio is used, avoiding split/rename discontinuities without future corporate-action information. Dollar notional, coverage and first/last activity age accompany prices.
sparse_data: At least four positive-volume, positive-trade-count on-grid bars are needed for the seven numeric summaries. Coverage and trade ages are always available; no trades gives coverage=0 and both ages=1. Missing numeric inputs use TRAIN-ONLY means, never forward fill or drop a member/outcome. Sparse trading is not certified as vendor completeness.
architecture: Original five-input THINK+mixer core plus identical shared per-stock 320-to-16-to-1 auxiliary branches for all three views. Auxiliary output head starts at zero; bounded eligible-centered correction is half detached core-score SD times centered tanh. Daily control bypasses the auxiliary branch exactly. Both core and auxiliary parameters learn jointly for augmented views; this is not the preceding frozen-core correction experiment.
matching: Core initialization, optimizer, training order, loss, graph and checkpoint selection match the original five-feature experiment. Daily control must reproduce all 40 available original/seed-expansion annual validation/test exports and selected epochs. All three parameter inventories are identical; daily has unused auxiliary capacity.
input_scaling: Core uses original train-only standardization, clipping at eight SD and scale 0.2. Auxiliary channels use training-eligible finite observations only, same clipping and scale; flatten 16 x 20 features per stock. AH view pads PM channels; daily pads all extra channels.
target_and_loss: Observed five-session stock economic returns in percentage points; original masked global MSE per chronological batch.
checkpoint_selection: Earliest best prior-year validation MSE improvement exceeding 1e-7; no test metric used. Same original purged annual indices for every view.
primary_comparison: Ten-seed after_hours minus daily, fixed equal top ten, full exposure and base modeled costs. after_hours_premarket minus after_hours tests incremental premarket information. Neither view is selected by test returns.
accounts: 66 accounts: each view's ten-seed/original-five/new-five ensemble at three costs (27), each individual seed at base costs (30), SPY/QQQ buy-and-hold at three costs (6), monthly index basket at three costs (3).
confidence: 10000 joint daily circular-block samples, blocks 5/20/60. Primary 20. One nine-contrast active-mean family covers each primary view versus SPY and QQQ (six), AH minus daily, AH+PM minus daily and AH+PM minus AH (three). Original-five contrasts are disclosed separately as diagnostics. Pointwise absolute Sharpe intervals use the same methodology as the comparison workbook, with a 3% annual hurdle.
stop_rule: Review features, pass tests and freeze data/source/protocol before all 120 fits. Finish and hash-lock every fit before new test financial/ranking metrics. Independently reproduce all checkpoints, data timing, daily baselines and accounts; publish every view, seed group, seed, cost and negative outcome.
history: 2022-2025 has been repeatedly inspected. This is exploratory development, not unseen confirmation or evidence of guaranteed future superiority. No trades or recurring jobs.
